artists.name: Artists
artists.description: Guess the Master's secret word correctly using yes/no questions, and identify the Con Artist!

conArtist.name: Con Artist
conArtist.description: Help the artists of the Artists guess the Master's secret word without giving yourself away!

master.name: Master
master.description: Answer yes/no questions to help the group guess your secret word, and identify the Con Artist!

roleInfo.name: Artist
roleInfo.description: You are an Artist. Help draw the Master's secret word and identify the Con Artist!

roleInfo.name: Master
roleInfo.description: You come up with a secret word at the start of the round, and tell everyone the category. Everyone helps draw the word, but the Con Artist doesn't know the word. Identify the Con Artist once the drawing is complete!

roleInfo.name: Con Artist
roleInfo.description: Help draw the Master's word, even though you don't know what the word is. Avoid being caught, or guess the word if you are!

params.value: As the Con Artist, you don't know the word! Each player will get ($1) to add something to the drawing.

preset.header: The goal of the Con Artist...
preset.text:
... is to NOT get voted out when the drawing is done.

However, if the group DOES successfully identify the Con Artist, the Con Artist can STILL win by correctly guessing the secret word. Therefore, Artists cannot make their drawing too obvious otherwise they are helping the Con Artist.

preset.title: VOTE FOR CON ARTIST
preset.question: Now, who do you think the Con Artist is? The vote ends when the majority of players vote at one player.

params.name: thenValue
params.value: And the majority of you voted correctly! But wait, the Con Artist isn't done...

params.name: elseValue
params.value: But the majority of you did NOT vote correctly. The Con Artist wins!
